Catalog metadata and bounded byte checks do not establish audible host playback.
evidence: DIAL-006 candidate 164ed275bf510869410c1df8fcf42a460510e5e6 had independent Review attempt 2 result HUMAN_DECISION: code findings were resolved, but required US coverage was unmet; ES remained blocked and DE/JP rows were not directly checked.

Owner answered yes to expanding finite candidates rather than shipping partial coverage; DIAL-006 lifecycle records that response and creates this successor to preserve the code candidate and pursue the same coverage objective.

Dated 2026-11-06 coverage evidence: current DIAL-006 sample had US 0 accepted, ES 0, DE one catalog URL, JP one catalog URL. Existing listed leads include US SomaFM endpoints that freshly returned 403, DE SWR and JP Gensokyo URLs that redirected, and ES Los 40 URL that redirected.

The earlier TECH.md lists investigation-only leads liveradio.swr.de or stream.0nlineradio.com (DE), stream.gensokyoradio.net or stream.zeno.fm (JP), playerservices.streamtheworld.com or stream.zeno.fm (ES), and ice5.somafm.com (US). These are not admitted origins: the checked-in evidence does not establish compliant direct stream behavior for them.

No exact provider UUID values for new US/DE/JP/ES candidates were found in the carried DIAL-006 coverage documents/reports. DIAL-006 only confirms exact UUID overrides for the two French Meuh/Nova entries, without exposing their values in the summary evidence.
This Triage performed no network probes, tests, or production edits. No new compatibility, UUID, or host playback claim is made.
open_questions: Which fresh candidate station endpoints and exact Radio Browser UUIDs pass dated redirect-rejecting HTTPS checks for US, DE, JP, and ES, and which finite origins are justified by those results?
For existing CA/IT/FR/GB candidates, which direct-stream and host checks should be refreshed or retained as sufficient evidence for the revised Spec?
What representative station set will owner host QA use to establish actual playback, CSP acceptance, and More-state continuity before coverage acceptance?
relevant_code: src/media-policy.ts: exact shared server/browser/CSP origins currently include Radio Paradise, BFM, Musicradio, radio.co, United Radio, Meuh, and Nova. No US, DE-specific, JP-specific, or ES-specific origin appears in the current finite set.

src/discovery.ts: provider rows require exact country, MP3, valid UUID, accepted media URL/origin, and deduplication; DIAL-006 added exact UUID overrides for Meuh/Nova while retaining the provider UUID for attribution.

src/player.ts, src/station-list.ts, and test/ui-harness.js: DIAL-006 carries bounded page append behavior, selection/playback retention, and generation guards for stale same-country and cross-country responses. Review attempt 2 accepted these code corrections.

factory/work-items/DIAL-006/PRODUCT.md and TECH.md: prior approved scope defines 50-row pages, at most 3 pages/30 results, exact finite origins, direct MP3 checks, and no proxy; it needs a new exact approved revision to admit additional candidates.
docs/DIAL-006-COVERAGE.md: dated coverage table records US and ES with zero accepted choices, DE/JP catalog entries lacking direct checks, and no owner host playback evidence.
risks: A candidate origin may redirect, return an incompatible MIME type, fail bounded MP3-byte validation, or be blocked by host CSP; admitting it from catalog metadata alone would weaken the finite media policy.
US SomaFM endpoints previously returning 403 make the previously considered US lead unreliable; do not restore it without fresh successful evidence.
DE/JP/ES catalog entries on radio.co and prior redirecting station URLs do not establish country coverage or direct compatibility.
Broadening the allowlist without exact UUID-scoped overrides could make provider-supplied rows expose unrelated media origins.
Changing the DIAL-006 behavior while extending the policy could regress playback continuity, More retry behavior, or stale-response protection.
No ChatGPT host playback or owner UI QA exists; absent evidence must remain blocked at Verify.
reports.scope: Complete the original eight-country coverage objective for FR, GB, US, CA, DE, JP, ES, and IT by revising the finite media-origin and exact-provider-UUID policy, while preserving the DIAL-006 bounded More stations behavior and reviewed stale-response fixes. Keep direct HTTPS MP3 endpoints, provider attribution, bounded reads, and host playback evidence as gates. Hosting, AAC, proxying, publication, and deployment remain out of scope.

reports.summary: Proposes exactly two new media origins, listen.181fm.com for US 181.FM The Beat and streams.radio.co for ES Café del Mar. Fresh dated Radio Browser rows and bounded redirect-rejecting direct probes support one MP3 candidate in each of FR, GB, US, CA, DE, JP, ES and IT. No new UUID override is needed. DIAL-006 reviewed pagination and stale-response fixes remain the implementation baseline. Native audio may redirect subject to host CSP; actual ChatGPT host playback, destinations and owner coverage acceptance remain unobserved gates. No production code or deployment changed.
